description.value:
Trigger an ally is struck in your line of sight

Effect off-hand shot at the attacker at a −2 circumstance penalty beyond your normal MAP, weapon damage only

Snap off a shot at whoever just hurt someone you're covering.

cinderfall.incomplete: reaction off-hand shot when an ally is struck in your sight. This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP. This is a cross-creature effect: it changes a DIFFERENT creature's own roll, HP, condition, healing, or item from the actor's own passive or activated ability, with no companion linked Effect item in this corpus to carry it (unlike the six real *-effect cards this class does have). No selector exists for this anywhere in pf2e-source.
